# EzyFusion Design System — Specification v0.1 (DRAFT, awaiting review)

Scope: a minimal, reusable UI language for a property-management / rent-collection dashboard.
It contains **no assessment-specific features**. All sample data in this document is fictional.

Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · lucide-react · Geist.

> **Version note.** The working directory is empty, so nothing is installed yet. This spec assumes
> the current defaults of `shadcn init` on Next 16: **Tailwind v4** (CSS-first config, `@theme inline`,
> no `tailwind.config.ts`). On the day, run `npx shadcn@latest init` first and reconcile section 2.3 with
> whatever it generates. If it generates Tailwind v3, only the "wiring" snippet changes, not the tokens.

---

## 1. Design principles

1. **Clarity over decoration.** A dashboard is read, scanned and compared. White cards on a cool-grey page, one accent colour, no gradients, no decorative shadows.
2. **One primary action per view.** Exactly one filled primary button per screen region. Everything else is `outline` / `ghost`.
3. **Data is the hero.** Numbers are right-aligned, tabular, and never truncated. Labels are muted; values are strong.
4. **Colour carries meaning, never alone.** Status = colour + icon/text. Money sign = `−`/`+` character + colour.
5. **Every async view has four states**: loading, empty, error, data. They are designed once, reused everywhere.
6. **shadcn first, custom last.** Only compose shadcn primitives. A custom component is justified only when it encodes a rule used 3+ times (e.g. `Money`, `StatusBadge`).
7. **Boring on purpose.** No animation libraries; only shadcn's built-in transitions and `animate-pulse` for skeletons. Time-limited work needs predictable parts.

---

## 2. Color and semantic tokens

### 2.1 Brand palette (given)

| Role | Hex | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `#1E40AF` | Contrast on white 8.7:1 (AAA) |
| Background | `#F5F7FB` | Page canvas |
| Surface | `#FFFFFF` | Cards, tables, popovers, inputs |
| Text | `#0F172A` | 17:1 on white |
| Muted text | `#64748B` | 4.76:1 on white ✅, **~4.4:1 on Background ⚠️** |
| Border | `#E2E8F0` | Dividers, input borders |
| Success | `#16A34A` | 3.3:1 on white ⚠️ |
| Warning | `#D97706` | 3.2:1 on white ⚠️ |
| Danger | `#DC2626` | 4.8:1 on white ✅ |

### 2.2 Contrast findings and the decisions they force (trade-off)

The brand colours alone do not pass WCAG AA (4.5:1) for **small text** in three places. Rather than change the given hex values, the system adds **derived tokens**:

| Problem | Decision |
|---|---|
| Success/Warning as text or white-on-colour fails AA | Solid `success`/`warning` are used **only** for icons, dots, borders, progress bars. Text on status UI uses darker `*-foreground` shades (below) on a light `*-subtle` tint. White text on solid success/warning is **forbidden**. |
| Muted text on `#F5F7FB` page background is ~4.4:1 | Rule: muted text sits on **Surface** (cards/tables) by default. Directly on the page background, use `--muted-foreground-strong` (`#526077`, ~6:1) — or place it inside a card. |
| Danger text on white is OK (4.8:1) | `destructive` is used as-is for text, and for white-on-red buttons (4.8:1). |

Derived tokens (Tailwind palette equivalents, chosen so they are easy to remember): success text `#166534` (green-800), warning text `#92400E` (amber-800), danger text `#991B1B` (red-800), tints `#DCFCE7` / `#FEF3C7` / `#FEE2E2`, primary tint `#DBEAFE`.
Pairs: 166534 on DCFCE7 ≈ 6.5:1, 92400E on FEF3C7 ≈ 6.4:1, 991B1B on FEE2E2 ≈ 6.3:1, 1E40AF on DBEAFE ≈ 7:1. All pass AA.

### 2.3 Semantic tokens (CSS variables)

Naming follows shadcn's contract (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, …) so every shadcn component works unmodified, plus three small extensions (`success`, `warning`, `info`). Components **never** reference hex or Tailwind palette colours (`bg-blue-800`) — only semantic utilities (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`).

```css
/* app/globals.css  (spec only — do not implement before approval) */
:root {
  /* shadcn contract */
  --background: #F5F7FB;
  --foreground: #0F172A;
  --card: #FFFFFF;
  --card-foreground: #0F172A;
  --popover: #FFFFFF;
  --popover-foreground: #0F172A;
  --primary: #1E40AF;
  --primary-foreground: #FFFFFF;
  --secondary: #EEF2F8;            /* subtle fill for secondary buttons / hover rows */
  --secondary-foreground: #0F172A;
  --muted: #EEF2F8;
  --muted-foreground: #64748B;
  --accent: #EEF2F8;               /* shadcn hover/focus fill for menu items, ghost buttons */
  --accent-foreground: #0F172A;
  --destructive: #DC2626;
  --destructive-foreground: #FFFFFF;
  --border: #E2E8F0;
  --input: #CBD5E1;                /* slightly darker than border: input edges need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) */
  --ring: #1E40AF;
  --radius: 0.5rem;

  /* extensions */
  --success: #16A34A;  --success-subtle: #DCFCE7;  --success-foreground: #166534;
  --warning: #D97706;  --warning-subtle: #FEF3C7;  --warning-foreground: #92400E;
  --danger-subtle: #FEE2E2;  --danger-foreground: #991B1B;
  --info-subtle: #DBEAFE;    --info-foreground: #1E40AF;
  --muted-foreground-strong: #526077;   /* muted text directly on --background */
}
```

Tailwind v4 wiring (maps variables to utilities; this is the only place tokens are registered):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@theme inline {
  --color-background: var(--background);
  --color-foreground: var(--foreground);
  --color-card: var(--card);
  --color-primary: var(--primary);
  --color-primary-foreground: var(--primary-foreground);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);
  --color-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground);
  --color-border: var(--border);
  --color-input: var(--input);
  --color-ring: var(--ring);
  --color-destructive: var(--destructive);
  --color-success: var(--success);
  --color-success-subtle: var(--success-subtle);
  --color-success-foreground: var(--success-foreground);
  /* …same pattern for warning, danger, info, secondary, accent, popover */
  --radius-sm: calc(var(--radius) - 2px);
  --radius-md: var(--radius);
  --radius-lg: calc(var(--radius) + 2px);
  --font-sans: var(--font-geist-sans);
  --font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono);
}
```

**Dark mode: out of scope.** Trade-off: shadcn ships `.dark` blocks, but a second theme doubles QA for zero assessment value. Delete the generated `.dark` block to avoid half-themed UI. The token structure supports adding it later without touching components.

### 2.4 Usage rules

| Need | Use | Never |
|---|---|---|
| Page canvas | `bg-background` | `bg-gray-50` |
| Card / table / dialog | `bg-card` + `border` | custom white |
| Primary CTA | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` | success-green for CTAs |
| Secondary text | `text-muted-foreground` (on cards) | `opacity-50` |
| Positive/negative state | `StatusBadge` / tokens | raw `text-green-600` |
| Focus | `ring` token (2px, offset 2px) | removing outlines |

---

## 3. Typography scale

**Font:** Geist Sans for UI, Geist Mono for IDs/references. Load via `next/font/google` (`Geist`, `Geist_Mono`) — zero extra dependency, self-hosted by Next, no layout shift. Expose as `--font-geist-sans` / `--font-geist-mono`.

| Token | Tailwind | Size / line-height | Weight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Display | `text-3xl` | 30/36 | 600, `tracking-tight` | Hero KPI value only |
| Page title (H1) | `text-2xl` | 24/32 | 600, `tracking-tight` | One per page |
| Section title (H2) | `text-lg` | 18/28 | 600 | Card / section headers |
| Subsection (H3) | `text-base` | 16/24 | 600 | Dialog titles, group labels |
| Body | `text-sm` | 14/20 | 400 | **Default** for all dashboard UI |
| Body strong | `text-sm font-medium` | 14/20 | 500 | Table primary column, labels |
| Caption / helper | `text-xs` | 12/16 | 400 | Helper text, timestamps, table headers (`uppercase tracking-wide`, optional) |
| Mono | `font-mono text-xs/sm` | — | 400 | Reference numbers, IDs |
| Numeric | add `tabular-nums` | — | — | **Every** number in a table/KPI |

Rules: base body is 14px (dense dashboard standard) but inputs are **16px on mobile** (`text-base md:text-sm`) to prevent iOS zoom. Max two weights per view (400/500, plus 600 for headings). Line length for prose ≤ 65ch.

---

## 4. Spacing and sizing

Use Tailwind's 4px scale; restrict to a short menu so layouts stay consistent.

| Purpose | Value |
|---|---|
| Inline gap (icon↔text) | `gap-2` (8) |
| Form field ↔ field | `space-y-4` (16) |
| Label ↔ control | `gap-1.5` (6) |
| Card padding | `p-4` mobile, `p-6` ≥ md |
| Section ↔ section | `space-y-6` (24) |
| Page padding | `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8`, `py-6` |
| Table cell | `px-3 py-2.5` (`h-11` row) |

Control heights: `h-9` (36) default desktop; `h-10` (40) on mobile; **minimum touch target 40×40px** (44 preferred for primary mobile actions). Icons: `size-4` (16) inline, `size-5` (20) in nav/empty states, `size-8–10` in empty-state illustrations. Lucide `strokeWidth` stays at default 2.

---

## 5. Border radius and shadows

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `rounded-md` (`--radius` 8px) | default | Buttons, inputs, badges (non-pill) |
| `rounded-lg` | 10px | Cards, dialogs, popovers |
| `rounded-full` | — | Status dot, avatar, pill badges only |

Shadows: **flat by default.** Elevation comes from `border` first.

| Level | Class | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | none + `border` | Cards, tables, inputs |
| 1 | `shadow-sm` | Cards that are interactive/hoverable |
| 2 | `shadow-md` | Dropdowns, popovers |
| 3 | `shadow-lg` | Dialogs, sheets |

---

## 6. Layout and responsive rules

### 6.1 App shell
```
┌──────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Sidebar 240px│ Topbar (h-14, border-b, bg-card)    │
│ bg-card      ├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ border-r     │ <main> max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4/6/8    │
│              │   PageHeader (title + actions)      │
│              │   content blocks (space-y-6)        │
└──────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────┘
```
- ≥ `lg` (1024): fixed sidebar. < `lg`: sidebar collapses into a **Sheet** opened by a menu button in the Topbar.
- **Trade-off:** shadcn's full `Sidebar` component is feature-rich but large and has its own state/cookie machinery. We use a ~40-line static `<aside>` + `Sheet` for mobile. Switch to `Sidebar` only if requirements need collapsible groups.
- Content max width `max-w-7xl` (1280); forms/detail pages `max-w-2xl`/`max-w-3xl`.

### 6.2 Breakpoints (Tailwind defaults, mobile-first)
`sm` 640 · `md` 768 · `lg` 1024 (sidebar appears) · `xl` 1280. No custom breakpoints.

### 6.3 Responsive patterns
| Element | < md | ≥ md |
|---|---|---|
| KPI cards | 1 col (2 col ≥ sm) | `grid-cols-4` |
| Form | single column, full-width buttons | 2-col grid for short fields, actions right-aligned |
| Page header | title stacked above actions | row, space-between |
| Data table | wrapped in horizontal scroll container; first column sticky optional | full |
| Dialog | full-width, bottom-aligned feel via `max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)]` | `max-w-lg` |
| Filters | collapse to one stacked row | inline toolbar |

Tables **scroll horizontally on mobile; they are not re-flowed into cards** (trade-off: card-reflow doubles the markup per table; scroll is acceptable for an admin tool).

---

## 7. Buttons and form components

### 7.1 Buttons (shadcn `Button`, no new variants beyond `success`-free set)

| Variant | Appearance | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | filled primary | The one main action |
| `secondary` | tinted neutral fill | Alternative main-level action |
| `outline` | border, white bg | Cancel, Export, Filters |
| `ghost` | no border | Row actions, toolbar icons |
| `destructive` | filled red | Irreversible action — **only inside a confirm dialog** or clearly isolated |
| `link` | text link | Inline navigation |

Sizes: `sm` (h-8, dense toolbars), `default` (h-9), `icon` (size-9, requires `aria-label`). Rules:
- Label = **verb + object** ("Record payment"), sentence case. No "Submit"/"OK".
- Leading Lucide icon allowed (`size-4`), never icon-only without `aria-label` + Tooltip.
- **Loading:** disable the button, swap leading icon for `Loader2` `animate-spin`, keep the label (no width jump), set `aria-busy`.
- Order in a footer: `[Cancel (outline)] [Primary]`, right-aligned; reverse (primary on top) on mobile.

### 7.2 Form components
Use shadcn `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `Label`, plus **react-hook-form + zod** via shadcn `Form` (or the newer `Field` primitives if `shadcn init` offers them — pick whichever the CLI installs; do not hand-roll).

Field anatomy (vertical stack, `gap-1.5`):
```
Label *                      ← required marked with "*" AND aria-required (not colour only)
[ Input                    ]
Helper text (muted, xs)      ← replaced by error text when invalid
```
Rules:
- Labels always visible (no placeholder-as-label). Placeholders = example values only.
- Validation: on blur first, then on change after first error. Error text is `text-destructive text-xs` with an `AlertCircle` icon, linked via `aria-describedby`; input gets `aria-invalid`.
- Form-level failure (server error) → `Alert variant="destructive"` at top of form, focus moved to it.
- Currency inputs: `inputMode="decimal"`, left adornment for currency code, right-aligned text; parse to **integer minor units** before submit (see §10).
- Submit button disabled only while submitting — **not** while the form is merely invalid (disabled buttons give no feedback on *why*).
- Destructive/irreversible confirmations use `AlertDialog`, not `window.confirm`.

---

## 8. Data tables and pagination

Built from shadcn `Table` (plain), not TanStack Table, by default.
**Trade-off:** TanStack Table adds a dependency and boilerplate; for a 4-hour task with **server-side** pagination/sort/filter (the correct approach for unbounded lists) it adds little. Introduce it only if client-side multi-column sorting/visibility is required.

**Table anatomy**
```
Card (p-0, overflow-hidden)
 ├─ Toolbar  (search Input · filter Selects · primary action)   px-4 py-3, border-b
 ├─ Table    (scroll-x wrapper)
 │    header: bg-muted/50, text-xs font-medium muted, h-10
 │    rows:   h-11, border-b, hover:bg-muted/50, selected = bg-muted
 └─ Footer   (range text "1–10 of 248" · rows-per-page · Pagination)  px-4 py-3, border-t
```

Rules:
- **Alignment:** text left; numbers/money/dates-with-time right (header aligned to match); status & actions at the edges. Row actions are a trailing `DropdownMenu` (`MoreHorizontal` ghost icon button, `aria-label="Actions for {row}"`); max one visible inline action.
- **Primary column** uses `font-medium`; secondary info on a second line in `text-xs text-muted-foreground`.
- Never truncate numeric cells; truncate long text with `truncate max-w-[…]` + `title`.
- **Sorting:** only sortable columns show a button in the header with `aria-sort`; icon `ArrowUpDown`/`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`.
- **State in URL** (`?page=2&q=…&status=…&sort=…`) via `searchParams` so views are linkable and Server Components can fetch. Reset to page 1 when filters change.
- **Pagination:** shadcn `Pagination` (Prev / numbered window / Next). Show the range text; default page size 10, options 10/25/50. Disable (not hide) Prev on first / Next on last page. On mobile show only Prev / "Page X of Y" / Next.
- Footer is replaced by nothing in the empty and error states.
- Selection/bulk actions: **not in the base system** (avoid inventing scope).

---

## 9. Status badges

One component, `StatusBadge`, mapping a **tone** to shadcn `Badge`. Pages map their own domain statuses to a tone; the design system defines only tones (no property/rent vocabulary baked in).

| Tone | Background | Text | Dot/icon | Generic meaning | Icon (Lucide) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `success` | `success-subtle` | `success-foreground` | `success` | Completed / healthy | `CheckCircle2` |
| `warning` | `warning-subtle` | `warning-foreground` | `warning` | Needs attention / pending | `Clock` / `AlertTriangle` |
| `danger` | `danger-subtle` | `danger-foreground` | `destructive` | Failed / overdue | `XCircle` / `AlertCircle` |
| `info` | `info-subtle` | `info-foreground` | `primary` | In progress / informational | `Info` |
| `neutral` | `muted` | `foreground` | `muted-foreground` | Inactive / draft | `Circle` |

Spec: `rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium`, 1px border in the tone colour at low opacity, icon `size-3`, **always text label + icon** (colour never the only signal). Title-case single words ("Paid", "Overdue"). Badges are not interactive; use `Button` for filters.

Preview (fictional): `✓ Paid` · `⏱ Pending` · `⚠ Overdue` · `ⓘ Processing` · `○ Draft`.

---

## 10. Financial display components

Correctness rules matter more than looks here.

1. **Never use floating point for money.** Store and pass **integer minor units** (e.g. cents) end-to-end; format only at the edge. (`amountMinor: number`, or `bigint`/string if API requires.)
2. **Currency is a prop, never hard-coded.** The assessment may not specify one; default comes from a single `DEFAULT_CURRENCY` constant. Formatting through `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency })` — no formatting dependency.
3. **Display:** `font-medium tabular-nums`, right-aligned in tables, no wrapping (`whitespace-nowrap`).
4. **Negative / credit / debit:** use a real minus (`−`, U+2212) or parentheses, plus colour — `text-destructive` for negative **only when negative is bad** (e.g. balance owed). Positive amounts stay default text colour; green is reserved for explicit "received/credit" indicators. Avoid rainbow numbers.
5. **Zero** renders as `0.00`, never blank or `-`; **unknown/missing** renders as `—` with `aria-label="No value"`.
6. Dates: `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, short unambiguous form (`12 Mar 2026`), `<time dateTime>` element.

Components (all presentational, no logic beyond formatting):

| Component | Purpose | Props (sketch) |
|---|---|---|
| `Money` | Single formatted amount | `amountMinor`, `currency?`, `tone?: "default"\|"negative-bad"\|"positive"`, `size?`, `signDisplay?` |
| `StatCard` | KPI tile: label, value, optional hint/trend | `label`, `value: ReactNode`, `hint?`, `trend?: {value, direction}`, `loading?` |
| `SummaryList` | Label/amount rows with a bold total line (breakdowns, statements) | `items[]`, `total?` |
| `AmountInput` | Currency field (decimal text → minor units) | RHF-compatible; `currency`, `min?` |

`StatCard` layout: `Card` · label (`text-sm muted`) · value (`text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums`) · hint (`text-xs muted`). Trend uses `TrendingUp/Down` icon **and** signed text.

Fictional preview: `Monthly total  $12,480.00` · `Outstanding  −$1,350.00` · `Collected  +$11,130.00`.

---

## 11. Loading, empty, and error states

Four shared components; every list/detail page uses them, so states are consistent and fast to wire.

| State | Component | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| Loading (page/section) | `Skeleton` blocks matching final layout | `animate-pulse` only; table → 5 skeleton rows with real column count; use Next `loading.tsx` per route segment |
| Loading (action) | Button spinner | See §7.1 |
| Empty | `EmptyState` | Centered in card; Lucide icon in `bg-muted rounded-full size-12`; title (`text-base font-semibold`), 1-line description, optional **single** CTA. Distinguish "nothing exists yet" (CTA: create) from "no results for filters" (CTA: Clear filters) |
| Error (section) | `ErrorState` | Same layout as Empty with `AlertCircle` in danger tint; plain-language message, `Try again` button (`router.refresh()`/`reset()`); **never** show stack traces or raw server messages |
| Error (route) | Next `error.tsx` | Renders `ErrorState`; `global-error.tsx` minimal |
| Not found | `not-found.tsx` | `EmptyState` variant with "Back to dashboard" |
| Feedback (transient) | `sonner` toast | Success/failure of mutations; ≤ 4 s; never the only place an error appears |
| Inline error | `Alert variant="destructive"` | Form-level or page-level blocking errors |

Copy rules: say what happened + what to do next ("Couldn't load payments. Check your connection and try again."). No "Oops!", no exclamation marks.

---

## 12. Accessibility guidelines (WCAG 2.2 AA target)

- **Contrast:** follow §2.2. Text ≥ 4.5:1, large text/UI components/icons ≥ 3:1. Input borders use `--input` (≥ 3:1 vs surface).
- **Keyboard:** everything reachable and operable with keyboard; logical tab order = DOM order; visible focus ring on every interactive element (shadcn default `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2`). Never `outline-none` without a replacement.
- **Skip link** ("Skip to main content") as first focusable element; `<main id="main">`.
- **Landmarks:** `header`, `nav aria-label="Primary"`, `main`, one `h1` per page, no skipped heading levels.
- **Forms:** every control has a programmatic `<label>`; errors via `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; on failed submit move focus to first invalid field; required indicated in text.
- **Tables:** real `<table>`, `<th scope="col">`, a `<caption class="sr-only">`; sortable headers expose `aria-sort`.
- **Icons:** decorative → `aria-hidden="true"`; icon-only buttons → `aria-label`.
- **Status & live regions:** toasts and async results announced (`role="status"`/`aria-live="polite"`; errors `role="alert"`). Loading regions use `aria-busy`.
- **Dialogs:** Radix (via shadcn) handles focus trap/return — always provide `DialogTitle` (visually hidden if needed) and `DialogDescription`.
- **Motion:** only `animate-pulse`/`animate-spin` + shadcn transitions; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` (`motion-reduce:animate-none`).
- **Targets & zoom:** ≥ 40px touch targets; layout works at 200 % zoom / 320 px width with no horizontal page scroll (tables scroll in their own container).
- **Language/meta:** `<html lang="en">`; descriptive `<title>` per page via `metadata`.
- **Verification checklist (10 min on the day):** tab through every page; zoom 200 %; run Lighthouse a11y; check one screen with VoiceOver.

---

## 13. Component naming and folder structure

```
src/
├─ app/
│  ├─ globals.css                 # tokens (§2.3) – single source of truth
│  ├─ layout.tsx                  # fonts, <html lang>, Toaster
│  ├─ (app)/layout.tsx            # AppShell
│  ├─ (app)/<route>/page.tsx      # + loading.tsx, error.tsx per route
│  └─ not-found.tsx
├─ components/
│  ├─ ui/                         # shadcn-generated, owned but minimally edited
│  ├─ layout/                     # AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, PageHeader, PageContainer
│  ├─ data/                       # DataTable (shell), TablePagination, TableToolbar, TableSkeleton
│  ├─ feedback/                   # EmptyState, ErrorState, LoadingState, InlineAlert
│  ├─ finance/                    # Money, StatCard, SummaryList, AmountInput
│  ├─ status/                     # StatusBadge
│  └─ forms/                      # FormField (label+control+helper+error), FormActions
├─ lib/
│  ├─ utils.ts                    # cn()
│  ├─ format.ts                   # formatMoney, formatDate (Intl)
│  └─ constants.ts                # DEFAULT_CURRENCY, DEFAULT_LOCALE, PAGE_SIZES
└─ types/                         # shared UI types (Tone, PageParams)
```

Naming conventions
- Files: `kebab-case.tsx`; exports: `PascalCase` named exports (no default exports except Next route files).
- Domain-neutral names in `components/`; **domain-specific compositions** (e.g. a payments table) live next to their route in `app/(app)/<route>/_components/`. This keeps the design system free of assessment logic and makes it trivial to delete/replace.
- Props: `className` always accepted and merged with `cn()`; use `variant`/`size`/`tone` (not `type`/`color`); booleans are adjectives (`loading`, `disabled`).
- Do not fork `components/ui/*` behaviour; wrap in `components/*` instead, so shadcn updates stay mergeable.
- Server Components by default; add `"use client"` only for interactivity (forms, dropdowns, search input).

---

## 14. Usage examples and composition rules

### 14.1 Standard list page (pseudo-JSX, illustrative)
```tsx
<PageContainer>
  <PageHeader title="Payments" description="All recorded payments." actions={<Button><Plus/> Record payment</Button>} />
  <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
    <StatCard label="Collected" value={<Money amountMinor={1113000} />} />
    …
  </div>
  <Card className="p-0 overflow-hidden">
    <TableToolbar>…search · filters…</TableToolbar>
    <DataTable columns={…} rows={rows} state={state} />   {/* renders skeleton / empty / error / data */}
    <TablePagination page={page} pageSize={size} total={total} />
  </Card>
</PageContainer>
```

### 14.2 Standard form page
`PageHeader` → `Card` → `form.space-y-4` of `FormField`s → `FormActions` (Cancel + Primary). Server error → `InlineAlert` above fields. Success → toast + redirect.

### 14.3 Composition rules
1. A page = `PageContainer` > `PageHeader` > stats (optional) > one or more `Card`s. No bare content on the grey canvas except the header.
2. Cards never nest cards. Use `Separator` or spacing inside.
3. At most **one** primary `Button` per `PageHeader`/card/dialog.
4. Money always through `Money`; status always through `StatusBadge`; empty/error/loading always through the feedback components. A raw `<span>$…</span>` or ad-hoc coloured pill in a PR is a review rejection.
5. Destructive flows: row action → `AlertDialog` (names the object, states consequence) → destructive button → toast.
6. Spacing between siblings via parent `space-y-*`/`gap-*`, never margins on children.
7. Reuse before create: check `COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md`; adding a new shared component requires it to be needed ≥ 3 times.
8. Responsive is done with Tailwind prefixes in the component, not JS media queries.

---

## Design decisions & trade-offs (summary)

| Decision | Why | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Keep brand hex, add derived "foreground" tokens | Honours given palette while meeting AA | 5 extra tokens to learn |
| shadcn token names + 3 extensions | Zero friction with generated components | Extensions need manual `@theme` lines |
| No dark mode | Halves QA/time | Not themeable for users who want it (easy later) |
| Plain shadcn `Table`, server-side pagination, URL state | Smallest viable, correct for large lists, shareable links | No client-side column features |
| Static aside + Sheet instead of shadcn `Sidebar` | ~40 lines vs. a large subsystem | No collapsible/icon-rail sidebar |
| Horizontal-scroll tables on mobile | One markup path | Less elegant on phones |
| Integer minor units + `Intl` | Eliminates rounding bugs, no dependency | Slight input parsing code |
| Tones in `StatusBadge`, not domain statuses | No invented requirements | Each page writes a 5-line status→tone map |
| 14px base text | Dashboard density | 16px needed on mobile inputs (handled) |

## Open questions for review
1. Is the AA-driven addition of derived tokens (§2.2) acceptable, or should brand hex be used verbatim even where contrast is short?
2. Is **dark mode** definitively out? (Recommended: yes.)
3. Default **currency/locale** for previews — assume `USD / en-US` as a placeholder?
4. Form stack: OK to include `react-hook-form` + `zod` (the only non-shadcn runtime deps) — or use native forms + Server Actions only?
5. Should `DataTable` be a thin shell (recommended) or adopt TanStack Table now?

# EzyFusion — UI Implementation Plan (DRAFT, awaiting review)

**Status:** specification only. No application code will be written until `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`,
`COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md` and this plan are reviewed and approved.

## 0. Isolation and safety constraints
- Prep work lives in its own directory: `~/tect-task/ezyfusion-ui-kit/` (separate from any assessment repo). Not a git repo, nothing committed, pushed or deployed.
- The assessment portal is not accessed; the assessment timer is not started.
- Only fictional sample data (e.g. "Unit 4B", "Alex Rivera", `$1,250.00`) in preview pages.
- **Hand-over strategy:** when the real assessment starts, copy (not link) these folders into the assessment repo: `src/components/{layout,data,feedback,status,finance,forms}`, `src/lib/{format,constants,url-state}.ts`, the token block from `globals.css`. Remove the `/design` preview route. No shared package, no monorepo — copying is faster and has no coupling.

## 1. Phases

| Phase | Goal | Est. | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0 – Approval** | Review the three docs, answer open questions | — | You approve |
| **1 – Scaffold & tokens** | Next 16 + TS + Tailwind + shadcn init; fonts; tokens; P0 shadcn components | 30 min | `/design` renders tokens page, no console errors |
| **2 – Layout & feedback** | AppShell, PageHeader, EmptyState/ErrorState/Skeletons, StatusBadge | 40 min | Mobile + desktop shell works; keyboard nav OK |
| **3 – Data & finance** | DataTable, pagination (URL state), Money, StatCard, forms | 60 min | Preview table with all 4 states |
| **4 – Verify & document** | a11y pass, contrast check, README of usage, "day-of checklist" | 30 min | Checklist in §5 all green |

Total prep ≈ 2.5–3 h of work, done **before** the assessment so the 4-hour window is spent on features.

## 2. Phase detail

### Phase 1 — Scaffold & tokens
1. `npx create-next-app@latest ezyfusion-ui-kit` (TypeScript, App Router, Tailwind, ESLint, `src/` dir, no Turbopack opt-out needed).
2. `npx shadcn@latest init` → accept defaults; **record the Tailwind/shadcn versions it installs** and reconcile `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §2.3` if they differ (the spec assumes Tailwind v4).
3. Replace generated colour variables with the spec tokens; delete the `.dark` block; add success/warning/danger/info extensions and `@theme inline` mappings.
4. Load Geist Sans + Geist Mono via `next/font/google`, wire `--font-geist-*`; set `<html lang="en" class="font-sans antialiased">`, `bg-background text-foreground`.
5. Add P0 shadcn components in one command.
6. Create `/design` route: token swatches, type scale, buttons, form controls (fictional).
- **Verify:** `npm run build` + `npm run lint` pass; visually compare swatches with the spec hex values; check contrast pairs from §2.2.

### Phase 2 — Layout & feedback
1. `AppShell`, `Sidebar` (static aside ≥ lg, `Sheet` < lg), `Topbar`, `PageContainer`, `PageHeader`, `SkipLink`.
2. `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `InlineAlert`, `ConfirmDialog`, `TableSkeleton`, `LoadingState`.
3. `StatusBadge` with five tones.
4. Extend `/design` with these, including all variants.
- **Verify:** resize 320 → 1440 px; keyboard-only navigation (open Sheet, close with Esc, focus returns); `prefers-reduced-motion`.

### Phase 3 — Data & finance
1. `lib/format.ts` (`formatMoney` with minor units, `formatDate`) with a handful of table-driven unit checks (negative, zero, large, 0-decimal currency).
2. `Money`, `StatCard`, `SummaryList`, `AmountInput`.
3. `DataTable` shell (4 states), `TableToolbar`, `TableSearch`, `TableFilterSelect`, `TablePagination`, `RowActions`, URL-state helper.
4. `FormField`, `FormActions`, `SubmitButton` with RHF + zod example (fictional "sample record" form; no business logic).
5. `/design/table` demo with a fake in-memory dataset (≈ 57 rows) to exercise pagination, search, filter, sort, plus `?state=loading|empty|error` switches.
- **Verify:** reload preserves URL state; page resets to 1 on filter change; screen-reader names on row actions; numeric alignment; no float arithmetic on money.

### Phase 4 — Verify & document
1. Lighthouse a11y ≥ 95 on `/design`; 200 % zoom; VoiceOver pass on table + dialog.
2. Write a 1-page `README.md` in the kit: how to copy into the assessment repo, the composition rules, the component list.
3. Produce the **day-of checklist** (§5).

## 3. What will deliberately NOT be built
Dark mode · charts · date-range pickers · bulk selection · drag-and-drop · i18n/RTL framework · auth screens · any domain model (properties, tenants, leases, payments) · animations beyond spinner/pulse · Storybook (the `/design` route is the living style guide — zero extra tooling).

## 4. Risks and mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|

and its priority. **P0** = needed in the first 30 minutes; **P1** = add when a feature needs it;

| Component | Priority | Source | Used for |

| `badge` | P0 | shadcn | Base for `StatusBadge` |
| `skeleton` | P0 | shadcn | Loading |
| `alert` | P0 | shadcn | Inline errors/info |

| Component | Pri | Source | Purpose | Key props |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FormField` | P0 | compose (`form`) | Label + control + helper + error wiring | `name`, `label`, `description?`, `required?` |
| `FormActions` | P0 | custom | Cancel + primary footer, loading state | `submitLabel`, `submitting`, `onCancel?` |
| `SubmitButton` | P0 | compose over `button` | Spinner + `aria-busy` | `loading`, `children` |

| Module | Pri | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `utils.ts` | P0 | `cn()` (shadcn-generated) |
| `format.ts` | P0 | `formatMoney(amountMinor, currency, locale)`, `formatDate(...)`, `formatNumber(...)` — Intl only |
| `constants.ts` | P0 | `DEFAULT_CURRENCY`, `DEFAULT_LOCALE`, `PAGE_SIZES = [10, 25, 50]` |
| `url-state.ts` | P1 | helpers to read/write `page/q/sort/filters` search params |

## C. Dependencies

| Package | Why | Required? |
|---|---|---|
| `next`, `react`, `typescript`, `tailwindcss` | Stack | yes |
| `lucide-react` | Icons (shadcn default) | yes |
| `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `tw-animate-css` | shadcn runtime (installed by CLI) | yes (CLI) |
| Radix packages | Pulled in per shadcn component | yes (CLI) |
| `sonner` | Toasts | yes |
| `react-hook-form`, `zod`, `@hookform/resolvers` | Forms/validation | **recommended, open question #4** |
| Geist | Via `next/font/google` | no extra dependency |
| TanStack Table, date libs, chart libs, animation libs | — | **no** unless requirements force it |

## D. Rules for adding to this inventory
1. Prefer a shadcn component; if none fits, compose; custom only as last resort.
2. A new shared component needs ≥ 3 call sites (otherwise keep it in the route's `_components/`).
3. Every shared component must handle: `className` passthrough, keyboard use, all four data states where relevant, and have a fictional-data preview in the `/design` preview route (see implementation plan).
4. Domain components (e.g. "rent payments table") are **not** added here — they are composed from this inventory inside the assessment repo.

**Decisions that need your approval**
1. **Brand colours fail contrast in three places.** I checked these by hand.
   - Success and warning fail WCAG AA as small text on white, at about 3.3:1 and 3.2:1.
   - Muted text on the `#F5F7FB` page background is about 4.4:1.

2. **Tailwind v4 is assumed.** The directory was empty, so nothing is installed yet. The spec uses Tailwind v4's CSS-first setup. Phase 1 runs `shadcn init` first and reconciles the token block with whatever it generates.

   - A static sidebar that becomes a drawer on mobile, instead of shadcn's full `Sidebar`.
4. **Money handling.** Amounts are stored as integer minor units and formatted with `Intl`, with currency passed in rather than hard-coded.
5. **Isolation.** The kit would live in `~/tect-task/ezyfusion-ui-kit/` and be copied into the assessment repo, not linked.

content.text:
I read all three documents. They were written earlier in this session, so I worked from their exact text. I changed no files and installed nothing. The only command I ran was a read-only Node script that recomputed the WCAG contrast ratios, and it found a real error in my own spec (section 5, item 1). Phase 1 has not started.

## 1–4. The decisions

The five open questions in `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` are the same as items 1–5 of the six approval items in `UI_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` §6. Item 6 is new.

| # | Exact wording | Decision | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DS: "Is the AA-driven addition of derived tokens (§2.2) acceptable, or should brand hex be used verbatim even where contrast is short?" Plan: "Token approach incl. derived AA foreground tokens (DESIGN_SYSTEM §2.2)." | **APPROVE WITH CHANGES** | Keep your brand hex values. Add the derived tokens, with the fixes in section 5. |
| 2 | DS: "Is **dark mode** definitively out? (Recommended: yes.)" Plan: "No dark mode." | **APPROVE** | Dark mode is out. Delete the generated `.dark` block. |
| 3 | DS: "Default **currency/locale** for previews — assume `USD / en-US` as a placeholder?" Plan: "Placeholder currency/locale for previews (`USD`, `en-US`)." | **APPROVE WITH CHANGES** | Use `USD/en-US` for previews only. The real currency needs the assessment requirements. |
| 4 | DS: "Form stack: OK to include `react-hook-form` + `zod` (the only non-shadcn runtime deps) — or use native forms + Server Actions only?" Plan: "`react-hook-form` + `zod` allowed as the only extra runtime deps." | **APPROVE WITH CHANGES** | Approve `zod` now. Make `react-hook-form` conditional. |
| 5 | DS: "Should `DataTable` be a thin shell (recommended) or adopt TanStack Table now?" Plan: "`DataTable` as a thin shell over shadcn `Table` (no TanStack)." | **APPROVE WITH CHANGES** | Use a thin shell, and simplify its state handling. |
| 6 | Plan: "Kit location `~/tect-task/ezyfusion-ui-kit/` and the copy-not-link hand-over." | **NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS** | Keep the isolation principle. Don't confirm the location or the copy plan yet. |

**Reasoning and trade-offs**
1. **Derived tokens.** Measured against your hex values:
   - Success is 3.30:1 and warning is 3.19:1 as text on white.
   - Muted text is 4.44:1 on the page background.
   - Changing the brand hex values would break your design direction. Derived tokens keep it and pass AA.
   - The cost is more tokens to learn, which the fixes below reduce.
2. **Dark mode.** A second theme doubles QA for no assessment value. The token structure can add it later.
3. **Currency.** A hard-coded currency is a latent bug. Only the requirements can say which currency, how many decimals, and whether amounts arrive as integers, decimal strings or floats.
4. **Forms.**
   - `zod` is needed anyway, because server-side validation is the real security boundary.
   - `react-hook-form` pays off with about three or more non-trivial forms. For one or two simple forms, native forms plus a Server Action plus `zod` is faster and has fewer dependencies.
   - Decide this once the requirements are known.
5. **DataTable.** TanStack Table adds boilerplate and little for server-side pagination. The thin shell is right, but its `state` prop duplicates Next's own mechanisms (see section 5).
6. **Location and hand-over.** I can't tell whether a pre-built UI kit is allowed in the assessment (see section 5). The kit also sits inside `~/tect-task`, which may become the assessment repo, so my own isolation claim is shaky.

## 5. Contradictions and inconsistencies

**Errors in the spec (fix before approval)**
1. **`--input: #CBD5E1` is 1.48:1 against white.** §2.3 says input edges need 3:1, and the token fails its own comment. Fix: use about `#7C8BA1` (3.46:1) or `#8391A7` (3.19:1).
2. **Muted text on muted fills fails AA.** `#64748B` on `#EEF2F8` is 4.24:1. Muted/secondary/accent are all the same `#EEF2F8`, so hover rows, badges and table headers can hit this. Fix: use `muted-foreground-strong` on any tinted fill, or lighten the fill.
3. **Token naming drift.** Tones are `danger` while shadcn says `destructive`. The doc has both `danger-subtle` and `--destructive`, and the `@theme` example elides the pattern. Fix: pick one name per concept.
4. **Token count.** §2.2 says "5 extra tokens". There are 11 extension tokens.
5. **`FormField` name clash.** My `components/forms/FormField` shares a name with the `FormField` that shadcn's `form` exports. Rename mine (for example `LabeledField`) or drop it.
6. **Touch target rule vs sizes.**
   - §4 says the minimum target is 40px.
   - The default button is `h-9` (36px), `icon` is `size-9`, and `sm` is `h-8` (32px).
   - WCAG 2.2 AA only requires 24px.
   - Fix: choose one rule and size the components to match.
7. **`aria-label="No value"` on a `<span>` (§10.5)** is not reliably announced. Use visually hidden text instead.
8. **Speculative building.** `DESIGN_SYSTEM §14.3` and `COMPONENT_INVENTORY §D` require three or more call sites before a shared component exists. Phases 2–3 build about 30 components before any call site exists.
9. **"Minimal" vs. size.** Principle 7 says "Boring on purpose", yet the plan budgets about 2.7 hours of prep and the inventory lists about 45 items.

**Gaps between the documents**
10. **Loading and error states.** §11 relies on `loading.tsx` and `error.tsx`, but `DataTable` takes `state: "loading" | "empty" | "error" | "ready"`. For server-fetched data the loading and error cases come from Next, so the prop duplicates them. Fix: keep `empty` and `ready`, and use the other two only for client-side fetches.
11. **Unit tests.** The plan (Phase 3) calls for unit checks on `format.ts`, but the inventory lists no test runner.
12. **`sonner` and `next-themes`.** The inventory says `sonner` is fine and there is no dark mode. The shadcn `sonner` template historically imports `next-themes` for dark mode. Verify at install and strip it if present.
13. **"Only non-shadcn runtime deps".** That phrase is wrong. `@hookform/resolvers` and `sonner` also count.
14. **Folder structure.**
    - `DESIGN_SYSTEM §13` lists a small `components/data/` set, while the inventory adds `TableSearch`, `TableFilterSelect`, `SortableHeader` and `RowActions`.
    - `LoadingState`, `ConfirmDialog` and `url-state.ts` appear in the inventory but not in the §13 tree.
15. **`next lint`.** The plan says `npm run lint`. I believe Next 16 removed `next lint`; the scaffolded script may call ESLint directly. Verify.

## 6. Unnecessary for a four-hour assessment

**Cut or defer**
- shadcn components: `switch`, `breadcrumb`, `avatar`, `popover` + `calendar`, `tooltip`, and `tabs` (add only if a screen needs them).
- Shared components: `SummaryList`, `DateText`, `LoadingState` variants, `SortableHeader`, `TableFilterSelect`, and `AmountInput` (build when the first form needs money).
- Folder and fonts: the `types/` folder, and Geist Mono (only needed if IDs are displayed).
- Plan items:
  - The `/design` preview route and the kit README (a tokens page is enough).
  - Lighthouse and VoiceOver passes as a formal phase (keep the keyboard and zoom checks).
  - The 57-row demo dataset with `?state=` switches.
- Packages: `react-hook-form` and `@hookform/resolvers` (see decision 4).

**Keep (high value, low cost):** the tokens, `Money`/`format.ts`, `StatusBadge`, `EmptyState`/`ErrorState`/skeleton, `PageHeader`, `ConfirmDialog`, `Button`/`Input`/`Select`/`Table`/`Pagination`/`Card`/`Alert`/`Sheet`/`DropdownMenu`, `sonner`, `SkipLink`.

## 7. Security, accessibility and financial concerns

**Security**
- **URL state is untrusted input.**
  - Parse `page`, `pageSize`, `q`, `sort` and filters server-side with `zod`.
  - Whitelist page sizes (10/25/50) and sort keys, and cap `q`, to avoid injection, an unbounded `LIMIT`, or an unsafe `ORDER BY`.
  - The spec doesn't say this yet.
- **PII in URLs.** Search terms could be tenant names, and URLs end up in logs, history and referrer headers. Don't put personal data in query strings; this matches your privacy rule.
- **Client validation isn't security.** Every mutation needs server-side validation and an authorization check. The server must recompute any total and never trust a client-computed amount.
- **Payments need idempotency.** Disabling the button while submitting isn't enough against double submit or retry. Use an idempotency key if the backend supports one.
- **Errors and the preview route.** Never render raw server errors (the spec already says this). Remove the `/design` route before any deploy. Never use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- **Supply chain.** Use pinned versions and minimal packages; the spec already leans this way.

**Accessibility**
- Input border contrast is 1.48:1 (section 5, item 1).
- Muted-on-muted contrast fails (section 5, item 2).
- **Toasts of "≤ 4 s" are too short.** WCAG 2.2.1 (timing adjustable) applies. Use 6 to 8 seconds for success. Errors must persist, or also appear inline, which the spec only partly says.
- **Row hover.** `bg-muted/50` on white is nearly invisible. Row hover needs a clearer cue (the spec uses it as the main highlight).
- **Sortable headers.** The spec puts `aria-sort` on the `th` with a button inside, which is correct. State this explicitly so it isn't set on the button.
- **Touch targets.** Section 5, item 6 above.
- **Focus on `ErrorState`.** Say when the failure message takes focus after a failed load.

**Financial formatting**
- **"Cents" is wrong for some currencies.** JPY has 0 decimals and KWD has 3. `Money` must get the exponent from `Intl` (`resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits`), not assume 2.
- **Large amounts.** `number` is safe up to 2^53. If the backend sends decimal strings or `bigint`, `Money` needs a string-parsing path. That depends on the API.
- **Input parsing.** `AmountInput` must handle locale separators (`1,250.50` vs `1.250,50`) and define a rounding rule. The spec says neither.
- **Negatives.** `Intl` output varies by locale: a hyphen-minus or U+2212. The spec says "use a real minus", so pick one approach: `currencySign: "accounting"` or a normalised minus. Also, "red when negative is bad" is a domain rule; it needs the requirements to define what is bad.
- **Totals.** Sum in minor units only, never summing displayed values.

## Proposed amendments

If you approve, I'll apply these to the specs and nothing else:
1. Fix `--input` and the muted-on-muted contrast rules.
2. Unify the `danger`/`destructive` naming.
3. Rename the `FormField` wrapper.
4. Use `Intl` for the currency exponent.
5. Add the URL-input validation rules.
6. Slim the inventory per section 6.

Please reply with your decision on each of items 1–6, or "approve all as recommended".

EzyFusion UI Design System — Specification Refinement
You are acting as a Senior Frontend Architect and Design Systems Engineer.
The Design System review is approved with the following amendments.
Your task is to update the existing specification documents only.
Files to update

* DESIGN_SYSTEM.md
* COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md
* UI_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

Required changes
1. Accessibility

* Fix the input border contrast to meet the applicable WCAG AA non-text contrast requirements.
* Fix muted text contrast on tinted backgrounds.
* Preserve the original brand colors.
* Introduce accessible derived foreground tokens where needed.
* Standardize button and interactive target sizes.
* Use a consistent 40px minimum target as our design preference, while documenting applicable WCAG requirements.
* Improve focus states and keyboard navigation rules.
* Ensure important errors remain visible until acknowledged or are also displayed inline.
* Replace unreliable aria-label usage on non-interactive spans with accessible text.

2. Design Tokens

* Standardize on shadcn-compatible semantic naming.
* Use `destructive` consistently instead of mixing `danger` and `destructive`.
* Correct the documented number of extension tokens.
* Ensure the token mapping is compatible with Tailwind CSS v4.

3. Component Architecture

* Resolve the FormField naming conflict.
* Prefer existing shadcn primitives.
* Remove unnecessary speculative components.
* Keep only high-value shared components in the initial implementation plan.
* Defer TanStack Table, advanced filtering, animations, and dark mode.
* Keep React Hook Form optional until actual form complexity is known.

4. Financial Formatting

* Use currency-aware precision.
* Never assume every currency has two decimal places.
* Use Intl.NumberFormat for presentation.
* Keep financial arithmetic separate from UI formatting.
* Do not introduce floating-point arithmetic for financial totals.
* Document the limitations of JavaScript number for large integer amounts.
* Defer API-specific money parsing and rounding rules until the assessment requirements are known.

5. Security

* Document server-side validation of URL search parameters.
* Whitelist sorting fields and allowed page sizes.
* Limit search input length.
* Avoid exposing sensitive personal data in URLs.
* Require server-side authorization for mutations.
* Never trust client-calculated financial totals.
* Document that payment idempotency must be enforced server-side.

6. Scope Reduction
Reduce the initial component inventory to:

* Button
* Input
* Select
* Card
* Table
* Pagination
* Alert
* Sheet
* DropdownMenu
* StatusBadge
* PageHeader
* EmptyState
* ErrorState
* MoneyDisplay
* SkipLink

Additional components must be added only when required.
Remove unnecessary demo datasets, preview routes, and speculative abstractions.
7. Implementation Planning

* Keep all preparation isolated from the assessment project.
* Do not assume prebuilt code can be copied into the assessment submission.
* Separate preparation from assessment implementation.
* Update the implementation phases and acceptance criteria.
* Verify actual installed package versions before implementation.
* Ensure the documented lint command is compatible with Next.js 16.

Constraints

* Documentation changes only.
* Do not create React components.
* Do not install dependencies.
* Do not start Phase 1.
* Do not access the assessment portal.
* Do not commit, push, or deploy.

Final Output
Provide:

1. Summary of changes per file.
2. Updated component inventory.
3. Updated implementation phases.
4. Remaining unresolved decisions.
5. Any contradictions still present.
6. Confirmation that no application code was changed.

Wait for explicit approval before implementation.
</pasted_content id="a84f">

It contains **no assessment-specific features**. Any numbers shown are fictional illustrations. The spec assumes the current output of `shadcn init` on Next 16, which is **Tailwind v4** (CSS-first, `@theme inline`, no `tailwind.config.ts`). All versions are **verified from `package.json` and the generated files before any implementation** (see `UI_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`). If something here conflicts with what is actually generated, the generated, verified reality wins and this document is amended first. --- ## 1. Design principles 1. **Clarity over decoration.** White cards on a cool-grey page, one accent colour, no gradients. 2. **One primary action per region.** Everything else is `outline` / `ghost`. 3. **Data is the hero.** Numbers right-aligned, tabular, never truncated; labels muted, values strong. 4. **Colour never carries meaning alone.** Status = colour + icon + text. Money sign = a sign character, not just colour. 5. **Every async view has four states**: loading, empty, error, data. 6. **shadcn first, custom last.** A custom component exists only if it encodes a rule used repeatedly (see `COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md`). 7. **Add on demand.** Anything not in the initial 15-component set is added only when a real requirement needs it. 8. **Boring on purpose.** No animation work, no dark mode, no extra libraries. --- ## 2. Money sign = a sign character, not just colour. 5. **Every async view has four states**: loading, empty, error, data. 6. **shadcn first, custom last.** A custom component exists only if it encodes a rule used repeatedly (see `COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md`). 7. **Add on demand.** Anything not in the initial 15-component set is added only when a real requirement needs it. 8. **Boring on purpose.** No animation work, no dark mode, no extra libraries. --- ## 2. Max weights per view: 400/500 plus 600 for headings. Prose line length ≤ 65ch. --- ## 4. Spacing and sizing 4px Tailwind scale; restricted menu: inline gap `gap-2`, label↔control `gap-1.5`, field↔field `space-y-4`, card padding `p-4 md:p-6`, section↔section `space-y-6`, page padding `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6`, table cell `px-3 py-2.5` (row `h-11`). ### 4.1 Interactive target sizes (standardised) **Design preference: every interactive control is at least 40×40 CSS px.** This is stricter than WCAG; it is a house rule for comfortable use on touch and pointer. | WCAG reference | Level | Requirement | Our position | |---|---|---|---| | 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), WCAG 2.2 | **AA** | ≥ 24×24 px, or sufficient spacing; exceptions: inline links in text, user-agent controls, essential presentation | **Legally the applicable bar.** Our 40px rule exceeds it. | | 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) | AAA | ≥ 44×44 px | Not targeted; 40px is a deliberate, documented compromise. | | Element | Size | |---|---| | `Button` default | `h-10` (40) | | `Button` `icon` | `size-10` | | `Button` `sm` | **removed** (not part of the system) | | `Input`, `Select` trigger | `h-10` | | Pagination links/buttons | `size-10` | | Dropdown / select menu items | `min-h-10` | | Table row | `h-11`; row-action trigger `size-10` | | Checkbox / radio (when added) | visual 16–20px, hit area ≥ 40px via padded label | Exceptions (documented, WCAG-permitted): links inside running text; native browser controls. Adjacent targets are separated by ≥ `gap-2`. **Allowed edits to generated shadcn files** are exactly two, to enforce this spec: (a) size variants above, (b) focus-visible classes (§12.2). Anything else is wrapped, not edited. Icons: `size-4` inline, `size-5` in navigation/empty states; default Lucide stroke. --- ## 5. Border radius and shadows `rounded-md` (8px, `--radius`) for buttons/inputs/badges; `rounded-lg` for cards, popovers, sheets; `rounded-full` only for status dots/pills. Flat by default (border first). Elevation: cards none (+ `border`); `shadow-md` dropdowns/popovers; `shadow-lg` sheets. --- ## 6. Layout and responsive rules - Mobile-first with Tailwind default breakpoints (`sm` 640 · `md` 768 · `lg` 1024 · `xl` 1280). No custom breakpoints. - Page structure: `main` (max `max-w-7xl`, centred, page padding) → `PageHeader` → `Card`s separated by `space-y-6`. - **Navigation shell is a route layout, not a shared component.** If the assessment needs multi-page navigation: a static `aside` at `lg` and above; below `lg` the same links open in a `Sheet` from a menu button. Whether navigation exists at all is decided by the requirements. - Forms: single column below `md`; 2-column grid for short fields from `md`; narrow container (`max-w-2xl`) for form pages. - Tables scroll horizontally inside their card on small screens (no card-reflow); numeric columns keep `whitespace-nowrap`. - Sticky headers/bars must not hide focused elements: use `scroll-margin-top` on focus targets (WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured). --- ## 7. Buttons and form components ### 7.1 Button (shadcn `Button`) Variants: `default` (one per region), `secondary`, `outline` (Cancel, Export), `ghost` (row actions, toolbar icons), `destructive` (irreversible actions, never the default focus in a confirmation), `link`. Sizes: `default` and `icon` only (see §4.1). - Label = verb + object, sentence case ("Record payment"); never "Submit"/"OK". - Icon-only buttons contain **visible-to-AT text** as `Label`, not just an attribute. - **Loading:** `disabled` + `aria-busy`, spinner icon, label unchanged (no width jump). Disabling is **UX only**; double-submission is prevented server-side (§13.4). - Footer order: `[Cancel (outline)] [Primary]`, right-aligned from `md`; stacked, primary first, below `md`. ### 7.2 Form fields (initial set: Input, Select) Plain composition: native `

+### 10.1 Principles — arithmetic and presentation are separate concerns
-1. **Never use floating point for money.** Store and pass **integer minor units** (e.g. cents) end-to-end; format only at the edge. (`amountMinor: number`, or `bigint`/string if API requires.)

-2. **Currency is a prop, never hard-coded.** The assessment may not specify one; default comes from a single `DEFAULT_CURRENCY` constant. Formatting through `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency })` — no formatting dependency.
-3. **Display:** `font-medium tabular-nums`, right-aligned in tables, no wrapping (`whitespace-nowrap`).

-4. **Negative / credit / debit:** use a real minus (`−`, U+2212) or parentheses, plus colour — `text-destructive` for negative **only when negative is bad** (e.g. balance owed). Positive amounts stay default text colour; green is reserved for explicit "received/credit" indicators. Avoid rainbow numbers.
-5. **Zero** renders as `0.00`, never blank or `-`; **unknown/missing** renders as `—` with `aria-label="No value"`.
-6. Dates: `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, short unambiguous form (`12 Mar 2026`), `<time dateTime>` element.

+1. **URL search parameters are untrusted input.** In Next 16 `searchParams` is delivered asynchronously (await it — verify against installed docs). Parse and validate on the **server** with an explicit schema (a small hand-written parser or `zod`): coerce types, apply defaults, and fall back to defaults on invalid input (never a 500 or a raw error).
+   - **Sort field and direction:** whitelist of column keys and `asc | desc`; the value is never concatenated into a query or `ORDER BY`.
+   - **Page number:** positive integer with a sane upper bound.
+   - **Search text (`q`):** trimmed, **maximum length (initial value 64 characters; set once and enforced server-side)**, with a matching `maxLength` on the input.
+   - Filters: values must be members of a known set.

+2. **No sensitive personal data in URLs** (query string or path): no national IDs, payment/bank details, emails or phone numbers as parameters; use opaque identifiers for records. Search terms that could be personal names are a known trade-off (URLs persist in history, logs, referrers); whether search stays in the URL is decided against requirements (§Unresolved).
+3. **Never trust client-calculated financial totals.** The client may display what it computes, but the server recomputes totals from authoritative records and ignores/validates any submitted total.

+4. **Payment idempotency is enforced server-side.** The client sends a unique idempotency key per user intent; the server stores and de-duplicates by it. Disabling the submit button is a convenience, not protection.

+5. **Every mutation requires server-side authentication and authorization.** Server Actions and Route Handlers are publicly reachable HTTP endpoints: each one authenticates, authorizes against the specific record (ownership/role), and validates all input. Hiding a button is not authorization. Checks happen close to the data access, not only in request interception.
+6. Errors returned to the UI are generic and actionable; details are logged server-side only. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; no secrets in `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`.

| Item | Add when… | Notes |

| `react-hook-form`, `@hookform/resolvers` | **deferred** | see §C |
| `sonner`, `next-themes` | **not installed** | `next-themes` is never needed (no dark mode) |
| Test runner (e.g. Vitest) | **not planned** | money/format logic is verified with a short script or by inspection; revisit only if a unit-test requirement appears |
| TanStack Table, date, chart, animation libraries | not installed | |

Geist comes from `next/font/google` (no package).

1. Uses semantic tokens only; passes the contrast rules in DESIGN_SYSTEM §2.2.

# EzyFusion — UI Implementation Plan v0.2 (REVISED, awaiting approval to implement)

**Status:** specification only. No application code is written, no dependency is installed, and nothing is committed, pushed or deployed until this plan is explicitly approved. Phase 1 has **not** started.

## 0. Separation of preparation and assessment

| | **Preparation** (now, before the assessment) | **Assessment implementation** (during the timed assessment) |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose | Decide the design language; confirm tool versions and commands work | Build the requested features |
| Location | Documents in `~/tect-task/`. Any rehearsal code (if approved) lives in a **separate throwaway directory outside any assessment repo** (proposed `~/ezyfusion-prep-sandbox/`, to be confirmed) | The assessment repository only |
| Output | These three documents (+ an optional notes file of verified versions/commands) | The submission |
| Code carried over | **None assumed.** Prepared code is never copied into the submission unless the assessment rules explicitly allow it. | Everything is created fresh in the assessment repo, guided by the specification |
| Portal / timer | Not accessed, not started | Started by the user only |

Principles:
1. **Do not assume prebuilt code may be reused.** The assessment's rules on pre-existing code, templates, boilerplate and tooling are unknown (§Unresolved). Until confirmed, only knowledge — not files — carries over. This includes scaffolds, components, and CSS.
2. The `tect-task` folder may itself become or sit near the assessment repository; preparation artifacts must be kept separate from it before any code exists (location decision pending).
3. Standard tooling commands (`create-next-app`, `shadcn init`) are the same tools the assessment would use; running them in the assessment repo on the day is not "prebuilt code".
4. No preview routes, demo datasets, or Storybook, in either track.

## 1. Version and command verification (precondition for any implementation)

Before writing any component, record the **actual installed versions and generated output**, then reconcile the specification:

1. `node -v`, `npm -v` (Node 24.x / npm 11.x observed on this machine; confirm they satisfy the Next 16 minimum).
2. After scaffold, read `package.json` and the lockfile for: `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `typescript`, `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `eslint`, `eslint-config-next`, `lucide-react`, the Radix package(s), and the shadcn CLI version/`components.json` style.
3. Confirm Tailwind major version (spec assumes v4). Inspect generated `globals.css` for `@theme inline`, `@import "tw-animate-css"`, generated `.dark` block, and `border-color` base rule.
4. **Lint command (Next.js 16):** the `next lint` command was removed in Next 16; verify the scaffold's `package.json` script (expected to call `eslint` directly, with an `eslint.config.*` flat config) and **use exactly the generated `lint` script**. Do not write `next lint` anywhere. `next build` also no longer runs lint, so lint is a separate step. Type checking is `npx tsc --noEmit`. Record the working commands.
5. Confirm Next 16 specifics the spec depends on: `searchParams`/`params` are Promises (`await`), Turbopack is the default bundler, request interception file naming (`proxy.ts` replaces `middleware.ts` — verify) if it is ever needed.
6. Confirm shadcn output: does the generated `Button` use `h-9/h-8/size-9`; does focus use `ring-[3px] ring-ring/50`; does `sonner` (if later added) import `next-themes`; is `destructive-foreground` emitted?
7. Any discrepancy → amend `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` first, then implement.

## 2. Phases

| Phase | Track | Goal | Gate to proceed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0 — Approval** | Prep | This revised spec is approved; unresolved decisions listed in §4 are answered or consciously deferred | Explicit written approval |
| **1 — Prep verification (optional, sandbox only)** | Prep | In a throwaway directory **outside any assessment repo**: scaffold, record versions (§1), confirm the generated tokens/focus/size classes, confirm lint/typecheck/build commands, confirm the 11 extension tokens produce utilities. Capture a short notes file. **Nothing is kept as deliverable code.** | All §1 items checked; spec amended if reality differed |
| **2 — Assessment setup** | Assessment | In the assessment repo, after requirements and rules are read: scaffold, `shadcn init`, apply tokens (§2.3–2.4), Geist fonts, allowed edits (§4.1, §12.2), add the first components needed | Acceptance A below |
| **3 — Feature build** | Assessment | Build requested screens using the 15-component set; add deferred items (inventory §C) only on demand; money logic in `lib/money.ts` only if totals appear | Acceptance B below |
| **4 — Hardening** | Assessment | Accessibility/keyboard pass, security checklist, remove unused generated components, lint/typecheck/build | Acceptance C below |

Phase 1 can be skipped entirely if you prefer zero prep code; in that case §1 runs at the start of Phase 2. **No phase starts without explicit approval.**

## 3. Acceptance criteria

### A. Setup (end of Phase 1 verification / Phase 2 setup)
- Versions recorded; spec reconciled with generated output.
- Lint, typecheck and build commands run successfully using the generated scripts (no `next lint`).
- `bg-success-subtle`, `text-success-subtle-foreground`, `bg-destructive-subtle`, `text-destructive-subtle-foreground`, `bg-info-subtle`, `text-muted-foreground-strong`, `border-input` all exist in built CSS; no `.dark`/`next-themes` remnants.
- Contrast check of every token pair in DESIGN_SYSTEM §2.2 reproduced by a short script; all required pairs ≥ stated thresholds (`--input` ≥ 3:1 on Surface, Background and `muted`).
- Button/Input/Select/Pagination/menu-item sizes match §4.1; `sm` variant removed; focus indicator is solid and ≥ 3:1.

### B. Features
- Only components from the 15-set (or deferred items added with a recorded reason).
- Every list view implements loading (`loading.tsx`), empty, error (`error.tsx`/`ErrorState`), and data states; important errors persist inline.
- Money rendered only through `MoneyDisplay`; no float arithmetic on money; currency supplied explicitly; no assumption of 2 decimals.
- URL parameters validated server-side with whitelists and length limits (DESIGN_SYSTEM §13.1).
- Every mutation has server-side validation and authorization; payment flows use a server-enforced idempotency key.

### C. Hardening
- Keyboard-only pass of every screen: logical order, visible focus, no traps, skip link works, sheet/menu/dialog return focus.
- 200% zoom and 320px width: no page-level horizontal scroll.
- Screen-reader spot check of one table and one form; no `aria-label` on non-interactive elements.
- No unused components/dependencies; `lint`, `tsc --noEmit`, `build` pass.
- No secrets in client code; no sensitive data in URLs.

## 4. Unresolved decisions (need your answer or the assessment requirements)

| # | Decision | Status | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | May any prepared material (files, snippets, scaffolds) be used in the submission? | NEEDS ASSESSMENT RULES | Assessment rules |
| 2 | Location of any prep sandbox (proposed `~/ezyfusion-prep-sandbox/`) and whether Phase 1 runs at all | Your call | — |
| 3 | Currency, locale, API money representation (string/int/decimal), rounding mode | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Requirements |
| 4 | Use `zod` or a hand-written parameter parser | Open; default: decide at first need | Requirements |
| 5 | Introduce React Hook Form | Deferred | Actual form complexity |
| 6 | Search term in the URL vs. non-URL search (personal-name privacy) | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Data sensitivity |
| 7 | Whether navigation (`aside` + `Sheet`) exists | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Page count |
| 8 | Authentication / authorization model and idempotency mechanism available in the backend | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Backend design |
| 9 | Negative amount style (`signDisplay` vs `currencySign: "accounting"`) | Open | Domain convention |

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Generated shadcn/Tailwind output differs from the spec | §1 verification, spec amended first |
| Prepared material not allowed in submission | Separation (§0); only knowledge carries over |
| Edits to generated components drift on shadcn updates | Limited to two documented edit types; recorded in notes |
| Time lost on setup | Setup is mechanical (§1, Phase 2); everything else is deferred |
| Money bugs | Arithmetic isolated from formatting; no float math; currency required |
| Security gaps | Acceptance B/C security items; server is the authority |

## 6. Approval requested
Please confirm: (1) this revised specification, (2) whether Phase 1 (sandbox verification) should run or be skipped, (3) the sandbox location if it runs, (4) how to handle the unresolved items in §4. Implementation starts only on your explicit instruction.

3. Standard tooling commands (`create-next-app`, `shadcn init`) are the same tools the assessment would use; running them in the assessment repo on the day is not "prebuilt code".
4. No preview routes, demo datasets, or Storybook, in either track.

## 1. Version and command verification (precondition for any implementation)

Before writing any component, record the **actual installed versions and generated output**, then reconcile the specification:

1. `node -v`, `npm -v` (Node 24.x / npm 11.x observed on this machine; confirm they satisfy the Next 16 minimum).
2. After scaffold, read `package.json` and the lockfile for: `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `typescript`, `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `eslint`, `eslint-config-next`, `lucide-react`, the Radix package(s), and the shadcn CLI version/`components.json` style.
3. Confirm Tailwind major version (spec assumes v4). Inspect generated `globals.css` for `@theme inline`, `@import "tw-animate-css"`, generated `.dark` block, and `border-color` base rule.
4. **Lint command (Next.js 16):** the `next lint` command was removed in Next 16; verify the scaffold's `package.json` script (expected to call `eslint` directly, with an `eslint.config.*` flat config) and **use exactly the generated `lint` script**. Do not write `next lint` anywhere. `next build` also no longer runs lint, so lint is a separate step. Type checking is `npx tsc --noEmit`. Record the working commands.
5. Confirm Next 16 specifics the spec depends on: `searchParams`/`params` are Promises (`await`), Turbopack is the default bundler, request interception file naming (`proxy.ts` replaces `middleware.ts` — verify) if it is ever needed.
6. Confirm shadcn output: does the generated `Button` use `h-9/h-8/size-9`; does focus use `ring-[3px] ring-ring/50`; does `sonner` (if later added) import `next-themes`; is `destructive-foreground` emitted?
7. Any discrepancy → amend `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` first, then implement.

## 2. Phases

| Phase | Track | Goal | Gate to proceed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0 — Approval** | Prep | This revised spec is approved; unresolved decisions listed in §4 are answered or consciously deferred | Explicit written approval |
| **1 — Prep verification (optional, sandbox only)** | Prep | In a throwaway directory **outside any assessment repo**: scaffold, record versions (§1), confirm the generated tokens/focus/size classes, confirm lint/typecheck/build commands, confirm the 11 extension tokens produce utilities. Capture a short notes file. **Nothing is kept as deliverable code.** | All §1 items checked; spec amended if reality differed |
| **2 — Assessment setup** | Assessment | In the assessment repo, after requirements and rules are read: scaffold, `shadcn init`, apply tokens (§2.3–2.4), Geist fonts, allowed edits (§4.1, §12.2), add the first components needed | Acceptance A below |
| **3 — Feature build** | Assessment | Build requested screens using the 15-component set; add deferred items (inventory §C) only on demand; money logic in `lib/money.ts` only if totals appear | Acceptance B below |
| **4 — Hardening** | Assessment | Accessibility/keyboard pass, security checklist, remove unused generated components, lint/typecheck/build | Acceptance C below |

Phase 1 can be skipped entirely if you prefer zero prep code; in that case §1 runs at the start of Phase 2. **No phase starts without explicit approval.**

## 3. Acceptance criteria

### A. Setup (end of Phase 1 verification / Phase 2 setup)
- Versions recorded; spec reconciled with generated output.
- Lint, typecheck and build commands run successfully using the generated scripts (no `next lint`).
- `bg-success-subtle`, `text-success-subtle-foreground`, `bg-destructive-subtle`, `text-destructive-subtle-foreground`, `bg-info-subtle`, `text-muted-foreground-strong`, `border-input` all exist in built CSS; no `.dark`/`next-themes` remnants.
- Contrast check of every token pair in DESIGN_SYSTEM §2.2 reproduced by a short script; all required pairs ≥ stated thresholds (`--input` ≥ 3:1 on Surface, Background and `muted`).
- Button/Input/Select/Pagination/menu-item sizes match §4.1; `sm` variant removed; focus indicator is solid and ≥ 3:1.

### B. Features
- Only components from the 15-set (or deferred items added with a recorded reason).
- Every list view implements loading (`loading.tsx`), empty, error (`error.tsx`/`ErrorState`), and data states; important errors persist inline.
- Money rendered only through `MoneyDisplay`; no float arithmetic on money; currency supplied explicitly; no assumption of 2 decimals.
- URL parameters validated server-side with whitelists and length limits (DESIGN_SYSTEM §13.1).
- Every mutation has server-side validation and authorization; payment flows use a server-enforced idempotency key.

### C. Hardening
- Keyboard-only pass of every screen: logical order, visible focus, no traps, skip link works, sheet/menu/dialog return focus.
- 200% zoom and 320px width: no page-level horizontal scroll.
- Screen-reader spot check of one table and one form; no `aria-label` on non-interactive elements.
- No unused components/dependencies; `lint`, `tsc --noEmit`, `build` pass.
- No secrets in client code; no sensitive data in URLs.

## 4. Unresolved decisions (need your answer or the assessment requirements)

| # | Decision | Status | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | May any prepared material (files, snippets, scaffolds) be used in the submission? | NEEDS ASSESSMENT RULES | Assessment rules |
| 2 | Location of any prep sandbox (proposed `~/ezyfusion-prep-sandbox/`) and whether Phase 1 runs at all | Your call | — |
| 3 | Currency, locale, API money representation (string/int/decimal), rounding mode | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Requirements |
| 4 | Use `zod` or a hand-written parameter parser | Open; default: decide at first need | Requirements |
| 5 | Introduce React Hook Form | Deferred | Actual form complexity |
| 6 | Search term in the URL vs. non-URL search (personal-name privacy) | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Data sensitivity |
| 7 | Whether navigation (`aside` + `Sheet`) exists | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Page count |
| 8 | Authentication / authorization model and idempotency mechanism available in the backend | NEEDS ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS | Backend design |
| 9 | Negative amount style (`signDisplay` vs `currencySign: "accounting"`) | Open | Domain convention |

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Generated shadcn/Tailwind output differs from the spec | §1 verification, spec amended first |
| Prepared material not allowed in submission | Separation (§0); only knowledge carries over |
| Edits to generated components drift on shadcn updates | Limited to two documented edit types; recorded in notes |
| Time lost on setup | Setup is mechanical (§1, Phase 2); everything else is deferred |
| Money bugs | Arithmetic isolated from formatting; no float math; currency required |
| Security gaps | Acceptance B/C security items; server is the authority |

## 6. Approval requested
Please confirm: (1) this revised specification, (2) whether Phase 1 (sandbox verification) should run or be skipped, (3) the sandbox location if it runs, (4) how to handle the unresolved items in §4. Implementation starts only on your explicit instruction.
